Pakistan Minister Threatens India Over Indus Waters Treaty

A Pakistani minister has issued a strong warning to India regarding the Indus Waters Treaty, stating "we'll cut off hands that try to tamper with it." The remarks were made in the context of discussions about water distribution from the Indus River system. This statement has drawn attention and condemnation from Indian outlets, with some framing it as a threat and others as a cry for help.
